title: reconcile declared and current artifact identity to zero or emit repair blockers

criteria: Declared/current comparisons are explicit and hash-bound to RC11 and RC12 source artifacts.

Drift-zero is true only when release id, payload digest, descriptor digest, manifest, checksum set, signature target, revocation, freshness, compatibility, rollback, support, and publication binding all match.
If drift remains, object trust, quarantine fetch, install, activation, rollback, support upload, recovery, remote dispatch, and production mutation remain denied.
